verdicts.title: Heavy-Quark Masses from the Fermilab Method in Three-Flavor Lattice QCD
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We report on heavy quark mass calculations using Fermilab heavy quarks. verdicts.title: Form factors for $B$ to $Kll$ semileptonic decay from three-flavor lattice QCD
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study the $B \to Kl^+l^-$ semileptonic decay process in three-flavor lattice QCD. We analyze several ensembles generated by the MILC collaboration at different lattice spacings and sea-quark masses. We use the asqtad improved staggered action for the light quarks and the clover action with the Fermilab interpretation for the heavy $b$ quark. verdicts.title: Boolean lattices in finite alternating and symmetric groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Given a group $G$ and a subgroup $H$, we let $\mathcal{O}_G(H)$ denote the lattice of subgroups of $G$ containing $H$. This paper provides a classification of the subgroups $H$ of $G$ such that $\mathcal{O}_{G}(H)$ is Boolean of rank at least $3$, when $G$ is a finite alternating or symmetric group.
